Title: Exact lists/columns
Steps: Inspect the three dedicated V2 list settings against COLUMNS.csv.
Expected_Result: Exact names/types/lengths; business fields optional; no extra operational fields.

Title: Fixed Categories
Steps: Compare the controlled initial category setup to CATEGORY-SEED.csv.
Expected_Result: Exactly KO Komputer; NK Non-Komputer; PL Perangkat Lunak; no invented Accounting mapping.

Title: Numeric lookup parents
Steps: Inspect Asset Types lookup targets/display values and a synthetic row in an approved test setup.
Expected_Result: Single numeric references to Organization and Category; readable display codes; non-unique and Restrict delete.

Title: Stable keys
Steps: Inspect unique index settings; later attempt an approved duplicate synthetic key in an isolated test.
Expected_Result: AssetTypeKey/BuildingKey text36 unique; keys separate from labels; actual rejection recorded only if executed.

Title: Label policy
Steps: Inspect Title settings on all three lists.
Expected_Result: Title optional text255 and non-unique; no unapproved duplicate-label policy introduced.

Title: Shared building shape
Steps: Inspect Buildings columns and later browse the same approved building from two authorized contexts.
Expected_Result: No entity/function parent or floor/room; same shared reference can appear across contexts.

Title: Versioning and preservation
Steps: Inspect versioning and built-in metadata; compare baseline resources.
Expected_Result: Versioning/retention recorded; original source and existing list consumers preserved.

Title: Unresolved context
Steps: Run merged startup with unresolved context.
Expected_Result: No catalogue rows returned; Refresh disabled; no automatic first-entity fallback.

Title: Category display
Steps: Bind approved context; open Categories tab.
Expected_Result: Three codes/labels readable; tab state visible; no maintenance buttons.

Title: Entity-specific type filter
Steps: Use approved A/B synthetic types and switch validated contexts.
Expected_Result: Only active current-entity types appear; correct CategoryCode label; no mistaken text code as numeric lookup ID.

Title: Active selection
Steps: Use approved active/inactive type/building fixtures.
Expected_Result: Inactive types/buildings excluded; no silent deactivation or write occurs.

Title: Tab behavior
Steps: Use all three tab buttons repeatedly.
Expected_Result: One gallery visible at a time; correct labels; no changes to source rows.

Title: Read-only actions
Steps: Browse/refresh with read-only reference permissions; compare before/after source values.
Expected_Result: No Add/Edit/Delete/Approve or flow invocation; all source values unchanged by the screen.

Title: Successful refresh
Steps: Change an approved synthetic reference through its authorized setup path; refresh screen.
Expected_Result: Updated reference observed; busy state clears; successful timestamp recorded for current context.

Title: Failed refresh
Steps: Use only an approved safe test connection/read-failure simulation.
Expected_Result: Safe error; busy state clears; no new successful timestamp or false empty-result claim. If safe simulation unavailable leave NOT RUN/BLOCKED.

Title: Context and freshness
Steps: Refresh A then switch through the context adapter to B; refresh B.
Expected_Result: A timestamp not shown as B freshness; no A type rows retained; B receives its own timestamp.

Title: Source permission boundary
Steps: Use actual restrictive identity; inspect permitted/denied list and app routes under chosen source access policy.
Expected_Result: Source permissions enforce required catalogue visibility independently of app filter; unmet needs trigger adapter correction rather than claimed isolation.

Title: Keyboard and labels
Steps: Navigate tabs/Refresh/galleries by keyboard and inspect accessible names/focus.
Expected_Result: Logical visible focus; no pointer-only operation; statuses not conveyed by color alone.

Title: Responsive readability
Steps: Check desktop/tablet and200percent zoom with long names/narrow widths.
Expected_Result: No hidden actions or unreadable labels; adjust actual control layout before acceptance if clipping occurs.

Title: Recovery and scope
Steps: Rehearse app-version recovery in approved test scope; inspect connected sources.
Expected_Result: Only reference sources connected; rollback preserves data/other consumers; no operational lists, writers, approvals or finance changed.
